node.title: Exact support-wise MCA numerator at full agreement
node.statement: For every proper linear code over F_q, the finite-slope support-wise numerator at full agreement is exactly B_mca(n)=1. The same one-slope construction gives B_mca(a)>=1 at every agreement. Hence q<2^128 has grand threshold zero, while q>=2^128 has a safe full-agreement endpoint. Combined with the rate-half pole floor, k+8,594,128,896<=a_RH(q)<=n.
